Card Q&A.a: Yes, it triggers.  The suspending and the timing for getting +1000 DP are the same, therefore the [All Turns] effect triggers.
Card Q&A.q: If an effect reads "[All Turns] While this Digimon is suspended, it gets +1000 DP," and 12000 DP when it attacks, does this card's [All Turns] effect trigger?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't.  It won't trigger if the DP is 12000 or less upon the attack.
Card Q&A.q: Can I activate this card's [All Turns] effect even when a Digimon with 12000 DP or less attacks and a [When Attacking] effect causes its DP to become 13000 DP or more?
Does this card's [All Turns] effect trigger when either my Digimon or my opponent's Digimon attacks?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] 1 of your Digimon gets +3000 DP for the turn. Then, 1 of your Digimon may attack.
[All Turns] When a Digimon with 13000 DP or more attacks, this Digimon may digivolve into [Marsmon] or [Callismon] in the hand without paying the cost.
